📚 **Help Menu**

Here are the commands you can use:

🎮 **Game Commands:**
`/guess` - Catch a character
`/harem` - View your collection
`/trade` - Exchange characters
`/top` - View global leaderboard

⚙️ **Settings:**
`/changetime` - Change spawn frequency
`/ping` - Check bot status
